$comment: Metadata snapshot the schema constants are generated from. Commit it.
Refresh a table:  dv schema pull --env dev --tables contact,account
A pull merges per table, so refreshing one leaves the others alone. Regenerating writes
src/Dataverse.Plugins.Abstractions/Schema/Schema.g.cs, which is linked into every plugin
assembly, making table, column and message names compile-checked.
This starter snapshot was written by hand so the repo builds before anyone has connected to
an environment. It lists only stock columns that exist in every org, so your first real pull
